en.headline: 6 commits across 3 repositories, plus 1 issue opened
en.summary: **6 commits** were recorded across three repositories, with 4 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 3 own commits split attribution correction data into SHA and identity segments, re-fetched the full local 10-23 dataset after merging and re-rendered it, and fixed missed personal commits using a SHA list. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, 2 own commits required the user's global Git identity for commits and added Chrome built-in translation while splitting contributor documentation. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 1 own commit made cards equal height, changed headings to sans serif, and added orange interactions and example boxes. The user opened or closed 1 issue: `openchamber/openchamber` #5489, titled "[Bug] "Run as goal" on a plan's Improve action arms an implement objective, so the agent starts executing the plan", which remains open with 1 comment. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 3 个仓库共 6 次提交，另新开 1 个 issue
zh.summary: 当天共记录 **6 次提交**，分布在三个仓库，另有 4 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 3 次本人提交中，将归属修正数据拆分为 SHA 与身份两段，合并后按本地整份重取 10-23 数据并重新渲染，还用 SHA 名单修复了漏计的本人提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 2 次本人提交中，要求提交使用用户的全局 Git 身份，并加入 Chrome 内置翻译支持及拆分贡献者文档。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 1 次本人提交中，统一卡片高度、将标题改为无衬线样式，并加入橙色交互与示例框。用户新开或关闭了 1 个 issue：新建 `openchamber/openchamber` #5489，标题为 "[Bug] "Run as goal" on a plan's Improve action arms an implement objective, so the agent starts executing the plan"，该 issue 仍为开放状态并有 1 条评论。当天没有 pull request、review、发布或讨论记录。
